title: "dicer kernel delete"

---

Deletes the kernels named, or with `--all` every kernel, asking first on a
terminal. A kernel an instance is defined to boot is refused.

## Usage

```console
$ dicer kernel delete (NAME... | --all) [flags]
```

Also run as `dicer kernel rm`, `dicer kernel remove`.

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-A`, `--all` | Delete all kernels. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | With `--all`, do not ask before deleting. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-D`, `--debug` | Trace every call to the daemon on stderr (or set `$DICER_DEBUG`). |
| `-r`, `--remote string` | Daemon to talk to: a remote's name, or an address (unix:///PATH or HOST:PORT) (default `$DICER_REMOTE`, then the current remote, then local). |
| `--request-timeout duration` | Give up on a single call to the daemon after this long, e.g. 30s (0: never; streams such as logs -f and exec are not bounded). |
